<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="incident">active=true^EQ<item endquery="false" field="active" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="true"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>AI Categorization (Async)</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeAsync(current, previous) {

    try {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        r.setEndpoint('https://api-inference.huggingface.co/models/typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli');
        r.setHttpMethod('post');
        r.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer 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");
        r.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");

        var incidentText = current.short_description + " " + (current.description || "");
        var body = JSON.stringify({
            "inputs": incidentText,
            "parameters": {
                "candidate_labels": ["Network", "Software", "Hardware", "Access", "Email", "Security"]
            }
        });

        r.setRequestBody(body);

        var response = r.execute();
        var responseBody = response.getBody();
        var status = response.getStatusCode();

        gs.info("[AI] HTTP status: " + status);
        gs.info("[AI] Response: " + responseBody);

        if (status == 200 && responseBody) {
            var result = JSON.parse(responseBody);
            var category = result.labels ? result.labels[0] : "Uncategorized";
            current.u_ai_category = category;
            current.update();
        }

    } catch (ex) {
        gs.error("[AI] Error in categorization: " + ex.message);
    }

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-23 09:08:24</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>255c510d83b87210a07896d6feaad36f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AI Categorization (Async)</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Intelligent Task Assignment" source="x_1259673_intell_0">c568deec83203210a07896d6feaad304</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Intelligent Task Assignment">c568deec83203210a07896d6feaad304</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_255c510d83b87210a07896d6feaad36f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-10-23 09:08:24</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=255c510d83b87210a07896d6feaad36f"/></record_update>
